Fact: data_curation
What to find: Data processing and curation (cleaning, filtering, deduplication, normalisation, augmentation).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Processing, Preprocessing

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: CSAM filtering applied at multiple stages of data preparation; automated filtering of certain personal information and other sensitive data; additional filtering based on content quality and safety in line with Google's policies. No deduplication, normalisation or augmentation stated.
quotes: **CSAM Filtering**: Rigorous CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) filtering was applied at multiple stages in the data preparation process to ensure the exclusion of harmful and illegal content.

**Sensitive Data Filtering**: As part of making Gemma pre-trained models safe and reliable, automated techniques were used to filter out certain personal information and other sensitive data from training sets.
**Additional methods**: Filtering based on content quality and safety in line with [our policies](https://ai.google/static/documents/ai-responsibility-update-published-february-2025.pdf).
